cards.key: Egor Demin is out, so Nolan Traore and Day'Ron Sharpe and Keon Ellis should play more than usual.

Sam Merrill and Jarrett Allen are out, so Thomas Bryant and Donovan Mitchell and Tyrese Proctor and Meleek Thomas and Evan Mobley and Peyton Watson should play more than usual.

Ja Morant and Robert Williams are out, so Donovan Clingan and Damian Lillard and Jrue Holiday and Deni Avdija and Scoot Henderson and Toumani Camara should play more than usual.

outs.note: The show noted that Orlando is still without Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs, and it said things will be tough for the Magic until both return. Banchero did not appear in Orlando's Nov. 5 box score.
Jalen Suggs remains out for Orlando and did not play on Nov. 5. The show said Anthony Black should still play sixth-man minutes or close to it once Suggs returns.

Robert Williams III played 16 minutes on Friday, and the show labeled him doubtful for Saturday on the second night of the back-to-back.

injuries.text: Brandon Miller left Friday's game against Boston in the second quarter with right groin soreness and did not return.
Jarrett Allen was questionable for Friday after leaving his last game with a knee injury, and he did not play. The show said the injury did not appear serious.

Kon Knueppel played only six minutes in his season debut on Nov. 4 before leaving with a recurrence of a leg injury that had kept him out for over a month. He did not play on Nov. 6, and the show said it is unclear how much more time he will miss.
